test.create_query: CREATE TABLE exists_limit_zero (c1 UInt64, c2 UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO exists_limit_zero SELECT number, number % 3000000 FROM numbers(15000000)
test.query: SELECT * FROM (WITH s AS (SELECT c2 AS k, count() AS c FROM exists_limit_zero GROUP BY k HAVING c > 1) SELECT k, c FROM s UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS k, 0 AS c WHERE NOT exists((SELECT 1 FROM s))) LIMIT 0 SETTINGS execute_exists_as_scalar_subquery = 1

SELECT * FROM (WITH p AS (SELECT toDate('2026-01-01') AS c9), s AS (SELECT c2 AS k, count() AS c FROM exists_limit_zero GROUP BY k HAVING c > 1), u AS (SELECT k, c FROM s UNION ALL SELECT k, c FROM s WHERE k < 10) SELECT p.c9 AS d, k, c FROM u CROSS JOIN p UNION ALL SELECT p.c9 AS d, 0 AS k, 0 AS c FROM p WHERE NOT exists((SELECT 1 FROM u))) LIMIT 0 SETTINGS execute_exists_as_scalar_subquery = 1
